newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle slow at $72 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle slow at $72 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area early Monday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not well tested. Feedlots reporting limited inquiry.

Sales reported on 100 slaughter steers; 200 head confirmed for the week to date. Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink. Slaughter Steers - Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1200 lbs 72.00. Confirmed - 100
